title: FragileFlow: Spectral Control of Correct-but-Fragile Predictions for Foundation Model Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2605.08896v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robust adaptation of LLMs and VLMs is often evaluated by average accuracy or average consistency under perturbations. However, these averages can hide a structured failure mode: a prediction may remain correct while probability mass already flows from particular true classes toward systematic wrong competitors near the decision boundary. In this paper, we formalize this phenomenon as margin-aware error flow and introduce FragileFlow, a plug-in regularizer that uses a calibrated margin buffer to identify correct-but-fragile predictions and organize their off-class probability mass into a class-wise vulnerable-risk matrix. Theoretically, we provide the first PAC-Bayes upper bound for this margin-aware error-flow object, showing how empirical spectral control yields a conservative route to deterministic worst-class robustness under a stability condition. translated_title: FragileFlow：面向基础模型鲁棒性的“正确但脆弱”预测的谱控制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）的鲁棒适配通常通过扰动下的平均准确率或平均一致性来评估。然而，这些平均值可能掩盖一种结构化的失败模式：预测可能仍然保持正确，但概率质量已经从特定的真实类别流向决策边界附近的系统性错误竞争类别。在本文中，我们将这种现象形式化为“边界感知误差流”，并引入FragileFlow——一种即插即用的正则化器，它利用校准的边界缓冲区识别“正确但脆弱”的预测，并将其类别外概率质量组织为类别级的脆弱风险矩阵。在理论上，我们为这一边界感知误差流对象提供了首个PAC-Bayes上界，展示了经验谱控制如何在稳定性条件下为确定性最差类别鲁棒性提供一条保守路径。在多项选择题LLM基准和少样本CLIP适配上的实验（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出即插即用的FragileFlow正则化器，通过校准边界缓冲区识别“正确但脆弱”的预测并将类别间误差流组织为脆弱风险矩阵，并首次给出该误差流对象的PAC-Bayes上界，从而以谱控制实现基础模型的确定性最差类别鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: FragileFlow is a plug-in spectral regularizer that identifies correct-but-fragile predictions via a calibrated margin buffer and provides the first PAC-Bayes upper bound for margin-aware error flow, enabling deterministic worst-class robustness for foundation models.
